simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָבֵת (H2281) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: חָבֵת (châbêth) means something fried , probably a griddle-cake First listed occurrence: 1Chr 9 31.

definitions.full: H2281. chabittim חֲבִתִּים noun [masculine] plural (Late Hebrew id. ) — some kind of flat cakes , or bread-wafers , only הַח ׳מַעֲשֵׂה 1Chr 9:31 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to cook (compare 4227 );
